parent: P4 (Viewer operations and reproducible export APIs) remains building
scope: Add an independent CLI that reads back a retained single PNG or GIF export and compares identity (exact byte length and SHA-256) and the container header against the schemaVersion-1 manifest. ZIP (png-sequence) and WebM are refused as unsupported. No encoder, viewer, solver or manifest version was changed.

fixtureProvenance.manifest: Real schemaVersion-1 manifests produced at test time by src/visual-export-jobs.js (buildManifest for PNG, comparisonManifest for GIF); no manifest fields were fabricated.
fixtureProvenance.png: Genuine 2x2 PNG built in the test with zlib-deflated IDAT and CRC32 (there is no in-repo Node PNG encoder; PNG export in the app is browser canvas.toBlob only), so the bytes are a real PNG, not a header-only stub.
fixtureProvenance.gif: Real 640x320 GIF built with the existing application encoder src/gif-encoder.js (createGifEncoder, 24 frames).

unverified: No browser (real Chrome) export was executed for this unit; the PNG fixture bytes are not from a browser canvas.
GIF frame count, duration, pixels and physical-result correctness are not verified by this CLI (frameCountVerified is always false).
ZIP (png-sequence) and WebM readback are not implemented; they are refused as unsupported, not verified.
Header identity only: the CLI does not fully decode pixels or prove visual correctness, so it is not full-decode or visual verification.
Public HTTPS, the full Skill loop and P4 parent acceptance are out of scope and remain open; completePreflight and P4 status are unchanged.
